newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa drops prices for May weekend.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa drops prices for May weekend.

text.p: German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG said it was dropping prices on a number of its domestic routes to 150 marks for the first weekend in May, a tradional short break for many Germans.

Lufthansa announced only in February it was cutting fares on domestic routes -- on which it says it makes no profit -- to as low as 222 marks, a move that was immediately followed by price cuts from one of its main rivals, Deutsche BA.
The new Lufthansa offer applies to a number of German destinations out of Berlin, Duesseldorf, Dresden, Hamburg, Hanover, Cologne/Bonn, Munich and Stuttgart.
The offer does not apply to flights out of Frankfurt, from which Deutsche BA does not offer domestic German flights.
